cultural.vision_reason: This is a Greek shadow puppet theatre (Karagiozis) scene photographed in Athens; the Turkish figure is a puppet character depicted by the Greek Karagiozis tradition, not an object made, worn, or used by Turkish people themselves.

physical.title: 35mm slide (photographic) (colour)
physical.summary:
Slide (colour); a scene from the heroic Greek shadow puppet play, Athanasios Diakos; the Greek shadow puppet Karagiosis, standing on the right, is on sentry duty on the Bridge Alamana; Karagiosis shoots the head off a Turkish man, whilst a second Turkish soldier runs away; Karagiosis is holding a pistol in his long extended right arm, and wears a torn green jacket mended with patchwork, a white shirt, red tie, and a fustanella (skirt); Athens, Greece.
35mm slide, polyester

cultural.vision_reason: This is a Greek shadow puppet (Karagiozis theatre) scene depicting a Turkish figure (Omer Vrionis in turban), but it is Greek folk art depicting Turks, not an object made or used by Turkish people themselves.

physical.title: 35mm slide (photographic) (colour)
physical.summary:
Slide (colour); a scene from the heroic Greek shadow puppet play, Athanasios Diakos; the Greek shadow puppet Athanasios Diakos, who was captured by the Turks, is being burnt whilst impaled on a spit; Omer Vrionis a Turkish General, is standing on the left, wearing a turban, whilst a Turkish soldier stands on the right, turning the spit; Athanasios Diakos' silhouette can be seen wearing a fustanella (skirt) and tsarouhis (red leather clogs with black tassels); Athens, Greece.
35mm slide, polyester
